from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from bridge.reader import Reader, ReaderFault, ReadOnlyClient, Settings, USERNAME, safe_url
from bridge.service import create_app


class FakeInstagram:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.user_id = "42"
        self.password = ""
        self.username = USERNAME
        self.authenticating = False
        self.data = {"cookies": {"sessionid": "synthetic-session-secret"}}
        self.fail = None

    def login(self, username, password, verification_code=""):
        self.password = password
        if self.fail:
            raise self.fail
        return True

    def get_settings(self):
        return self.data

    def set_settings(self, value):
        self.data = value

    def private_request(self, endpoint, data=None, params=None, **kwargs):
        assert data is None, "A read must not send an Instagram write request"
        self.calls.append((endpoint, params))
        if endpoint == "accounts/current_user/":
            return {"user": {"pk": "42", "username": self.username}}
        if endpoint.endswith("inbox/"):
            return {"inbox": {"threads": [{"thread_id": "123", "users": [{"pk": "9", "username": "friend"}], "last_activity_at": "1790000000000000", "items": [{"user_id": "9"}]}], "has_older": True, "oldest_cursor": "older_page="}}
        assert endpoint == "direct_v2/threads/123/"
        assert params["visual_message_return_type"] == "unseen"
        page = params.get("cursor", "")
        return {"thread": {"thread_id": "123", "users": [{"pk": "9", "username": "friend"}], "has_older": not bool(page), "oldest_cursor": "older_page=", "items": [
            {"item_id": "100", "user_id": "42", "item_type": "text", "text": "My synthetic message", "timestamp": 1790000000000000},
            {"item_id": "200" if page else "201", "user_id": "9", "item_type": "voice_media", "timestamp": 1790000000000001,
             "voice_media": {"media": {"audio": {"audio_src": "https://scontent.cdninstagram.com/voice.m4a?sig=fixture", "duration": 2300}}}},
            {"item_id": "300", "user_id": "9", "item_type": "raven_media", "timestamp": 1790000000000002},
        ]}}


@pytest.fixture
def setup(tmp_path):
    settings = Settings("test-token-" + "x" * 50, Fernet.generate_key().decode(), tmp_path / "private" / "session.enc")
    fake = FakeInstagram()
    reader = Reader(settings, factory=lambda: fake, clock=lambda: 100, sleep=lambda _: None)
    client = TestClient(create_app(settings, reader))
    return settings, fake, reader, client


def login(setup):
    settings, fake, reader, client = setup
    response = client.post("/v1/connect", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + settings.token}, json={"password": "synthetic-password"})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return {"Authorization": "Bearer " + settings.token}


def test_no_auth_and_no_write_routes(setup):
    settings, fake, reader, client = setup
    for url in ["/v1/status", "/v1/conversations", "/v1/conversations/123/messages"]:
        assert client.get(url).status_code == 401
    headers = login(setup)
    before = len(fake.calls)
    for url in ["/v1/send", "/v1/conversations/123/messages", "/v1/conversations/123/delete", "/v1/request"]:
        assert client.post(url, headers=headers, json={"text": "must never send"}).status_code in (404, 405)
    assert len(fake.calls) == before


def test_password_not_saved_and_session_is_encrypted(setup):
    settings, fake, reader, client = setup
    login(setup)
    raw = settings.session_path.read_bytes()
    assert b"synthetic-password" not in raw
    assert b"synthetic-session-secret" not in raw
    clear = Fernet(settings.encryption_key.encode()).decrypt(raw)
    assert b"synthetic-session-secret" in clear
    assert b"synthetic-password" not in clear
    assert fake.password == ""
    assert settings.session_path.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600
    restored = Reader(settings, factory=FakeInstagram, clock=lambda: 101, sleep=lambda _: None)
    assert restored.status()["connected"] is True


def test_validation_and_upstream_errors_never_echo_credentials(setup):
    settings, fake, reader, client = setup
    headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + settings.token}
    response = client.post("/v1/connect", headers=headers, json={"password": "secret" * 300, "arbitrary": "private-value"})
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert "private-value" not in response.text and "secret" not in response.text
    fake.fail = type("BadPassword", (Exception,), {})("synthetic-password synthetic-session-secret")
    response = client.post("/v1/connect", headers=headers, json={"password": "synthetic-password"})
    assert response.status_code == 409
    assert response.json()["error"] == "login_rejected"
    assert "synthetic" not in response.text and fake.password == ""

def test_folders_pagination_both_sides_and_unavailable_media(setup):
    settings, fake, reader, client = setup
    headers = login(setup)
    for folder, endpoint in [("primary", "inbox"), ("general", "inbox"), ("requests", "pending_inbox"), ("hidden", "spam_inbox")]:
        response = client.get("/v1/conversations", headers=headers, params={"folder": folder, "after": "previous="})
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert data["has_more"] and data["next_after"] == "older_page="
        assert data["conversations"][0]["id"] == "igp_123"
        assert fake.calls[-1][0] == f"direct_v2/{endpoint}/"
        if folder in ("primary", "general"):
            assert fake.calls[-1][1]["folder"] == ("1" if folder == "general" else "0")
    response = client.get("/v1/conversations/123/messages", headers=headers, params={"after": "older_page="})
    data = response.json()
    assert data["has_more"] is False and data["next_after"] is None
    assert [x["direction"] for x in data["messages"]] == ["outgoing", "incoming", "incoming"]
    assert data["messages"][1]["attachments"][0]["type"] == "audio"
    assert data["messages"][1]["message_page_after"] == "older_page="
    assert data["messages"][2]["content_available"] is False
    assert "synthetic-session-secret" not in response.text

def test_real_installed_client_blocks_message_writes_before_network():
    client = ReadOnlyClient()
    for authenticating in (False, True):
        client.authenticating = authenticating
        for endpoint in ["direct_v2/threads/broadcast/text/", "direct_v2/threads/123/items/200/seen/", "direct_v2/threads/123/hide/", "direct_v2/threads/123/approve/"]:
            with pytest.raises(ReaderFault, match="cannot change"):
                client.private_request(endpoint, data={"text": "never send"})
    client.authenticating = False
    with pytest.raises(ReaderFault):
        client.private_request("accounts/edit_profile/", data={"full_name": "blocked"})
    with pytest.raises(ReaderFault):
        client.private_request("https://evil.test/steal")
    with pytest.raises(ReaderFault):
        client.private_request("direct_v2/inbox/", domain="evil.test")


def test_current_caa_auth_host_allowed_only_during_login(monkeypatch):
    from instagrapi import Client
    calls = []
    def parent_request(self, endpoint, **kwargs):
        calls.append((endpoint, kwargs))
        return {"status": "ok"}
    monkeypatch.setattr(Client, "private_request", parent_request)
    client = ReadOnlyClient()
    endpoint = "bloks/async_action/com.bloks.www.caa.login.process_client_data/"
    client.authenticating = True
    assert client.private_request(endpoint, data={"fixture": True}, domain="b.i.instagram.com")["status"] == "ok"
    assert calls[-1][1]["domain"] == "b.i.instagram.com"
    before = len(calls)
    for domain in ("evil.test", "b.i.instagram.com.evil.test", "https://b.i.instagram.com", "b.i.instagram.com:443"):
        with pytest.raises(ReaderFault):
            client.private_request(endpoint, data={}, domain=domain)
    with pytest.raises(ReaderFault):
        client.private_request("direct_v2/threads/broadcast/text/", data={}, domain="b.i.instagram.com")
    client.authenticating = False
    with pytest.raises(ReaderFault):
        client.private_request(endpoint, data={}, domain="b.i.instagram.com")
    with pytest.raises(ReaderFault):
        client.private_request("direct_v2/inbox/", domain="b.i.instagram.com")
    assert len(calls) == before


def test_saved_session_restores_identity_without_old_twenty_second_pause():
    client = ReadOnlyClient()
    original = client.get_settings()
    original["request_timeout"] = 20
    original["session_retry_total"] = 3
    original["public_request_retries_count"] = 3
    device = dict(original["uuids"])
    client.set_settings(original)
    assert client.request_timeout == 1
    assert client.session_retry_total == 0
    assert client.public_request_retries_count == 0
    assert client.get_settings()["uuids"] == device
    assert original["request_timeout"] == 20  # Do not mutate the saved input.

"""Synthetic approval flow, including the library's encoded parameter format."""
import json

import pytest
from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from instagrapi.exceptions import TwoFactorRequired

from bridge.reader import Reader, ReadOnlyClient, Settings, USERNAME
from bridge.service import create_app
from bridge.verification import ENTRY, APPROVAL, VERIFY, server_parameters
from test_reader import FakeInstagram


def literal(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return '(f4i (dkc ' + ' '.join(json.dumps(k) for k in value) + ') (dkc ' + ' '.join(literal(v) for v in value.values()) + '))'
    return json.dumps(value)


def screen(action, params):
    # A dynamic client map must never be evaluated to extract static server params.
    expression = '(fixture ' + json.dumps(action) + ' (f4i (dkc "client_input_params" "server_params") (dkc (dynamic-untrusted) ' + literal(params) + ')))'
    return {"layout": {"bloks_payload": {"action": expression}}}


class VerificationInstagram(FakeInstagram, ReadOnlyClient):
    user_id = "42"

    def __init__(self):
        FakeInstagram.__init__(self)
        self.phone_id, self.android_device_id, self.mid = "fixture-phone", "fixture-device", "fixture-mid"
        self.logins, self.checks, self.opens = 0, [], []
        self.kind, self.approved, self.check_error = "approval", False, None
        self.entry_params = {"two_step_verification_context": "secret-original-context", "INTERNAL_INFRA_screen_id": "server-issued:3", "flow_source": "two_factor_login", "device_id": self.android_device_id}
        self.check_params = {"two_step_verification_context": "secret-poll-context", "flow_source": "two_factor_login", "INTERNAL__latency_qpl_marker_id": 36707139, "INTERNAL__latency_qpl_instance_id": 123456789, "device_id": self.android_device_id, "spectra_reg_login_data": None}

    def login(self, username, password, verification_code=""):
        self.password = password
        self.logins += 1
        self.last_json = screen(ENTRY, self.entry_params)
        raise TwoFactorRequired("must not echo", two_step_verification_context="secret-original-context", result=self.last_json)

    def bloks_app(self, action, params):
        assert action == ENTRY and self.authenticating and not self.password
        self.opens.append(params)
        if self.kind == "unknown":
            return {"layout": {"message": "An unsupported verification screen"}}
        if self.kind != "approval":
            self.check_params["challenge"] = self.kind
        return screen(APPROVAL if self.kind == "approval" else VERIFY, self.check_params)

    def bloks_async_action(self, action, params, **kwargs):
        assert self.authenticating and not self.password
        self.checks.append((action, params))
        if self.check_error:
            raise self.check_error
        return {"approved": self.approved}

    def bloks_apply_login_response(self, result):
        return result.get("approved", False)


@pytest.fixture
def flow(tmp_path):
    settings = Settings("fixture-" + "x" * 50, Fernet.generate_key().decode(), tmp_path / "session.enc")
    clock = [100]
    instagram = VerificationInstagram()
    reader = Reader(settings, factory=lambda: instagram, clock=lambda: clock[0], sleep=lambda _: None)
    client = TestClient(create_app(settings, reader))
    headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + settings.token}
    return settings, clock, instagram, reader, client, headers


def begin(flow):
    _, _, _, _, client, headers = flow
    return client.post("/v1/connect", headers=headers, json={"password": "fixture-password"})


def test_approval_keeps_one_login_and_finishes_only_after_account_verification(flow):
    settings, clock, instagram, reader, client, headers = flow
    response = begin(flow)
    assert response.status_code == 200 and response.json()["verification"] == "approval"
    assert response.json()["connected"] is False
    assert "code is needed" in response.json()["message"]
    assert instagram.opens[0]["server_params"] == instagram.entry_params
    assert not instagram.password and not instagram.authenticating
    assert not settings.session_path.exists()
    assert "secret-" not in response.text and "fixture-password" not in response.text
    assert client.get("/v1/status", headers=headers).json()["verification"] == "approval"
    # No new password login, even if a previous browser resubmits its form.
    assert begin(flow).json()["verification"] == "approval"
    assert instagram.logins == 1 and not instagram.checks
    clock[0] = 109
    response = client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={})
    assert response.json()["connected"] is False and len(instagram.checks) == 1
    assert instagram.checks[0][0] == APPROVAL
    assert instagram.checks[0][1]["server_params"] == instagram.check_params
    assert "code" not in instagram.checks[0][1]["client_input_params"]
    assert not settings.session_path.exists()
    client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={})
    assert len(instagram.checks) == 1  # Eight-second throttle.
    instagram.approved = True
    clock[0] = 118
    response = client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={})
    assert response.json()["connected"] is True
    assert instagram.logins == 1 and reader.pending is None
    assert settings.session_path.exists() and not instagram.authenticating
    assert instagram.calls[-1][0] == "accounts/current_user/"
    assert b"fixture-password" not in Fernet(settings.encryption_key.encode()).decrypt(settings.session_path.read_bytes())


def test_expiry_clears_pending_and_refresh_does_not_restart_sign_in(flow):
    settings, clock, instagram, reader, client, headers = flow
    begin(flow)
    clock[0] = 701
    assert client.get("/v1/status", headers=headers).json()["code"] == "verification_expired"
    assert reader.pending is None
    assert client.get("/v1/status", headers=headers).json()["code"] == "verification_expired"
    assert client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={}).status_code == 409
    assert instagram.logins == 1 and not instagram.checks and not settings.session_path.exists()


def test_code_method_is_explicit_and_does_not_restart_password_login(flow):
    settings, clock, instagram, reader, client, headers = flow
    instagram.kind = "totp"
    response = begin(flow)
    assert response.json()["code"] == "authenticator_code_required"
    assert "not requested a text" in response.json()["message"]
    clock[0] = 109
    client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={})
    assert not instagram.checks
    assert client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={"verification_code": "123456"}).json()["error"] == "verification_code_rejected"
    instagram.approved = True
    clock[0] = 118
    assert client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={"verification_code": "654321"}).json()["connected"] is True
    assert instagram.logins == 1
    assert instagram.checks[-1][0] == VERIFY
    assert instagram.checks[-1][1]["client_input_params"]["code"] == "654321"


def test_unknown_verification_is_not_claimed_to_be_sms(flow):
    _, _, instagram, reader, client, headers = flow
    instagram.kind = "unknown"
    response = begin(flow)
    assert response.json()["error"] == "verification_unavailable"
    assert reader.pending is None and not instagram.password
    assert client.get("/v1/status", headers=headers).json()["code"] == "verification_unavailable"


def test_approved_wrong_account_is_never_saved(flow):
    settings, clock, instagram, reader, client, headers = flow
    begin(flow)
    instagram.approved, instagram.username = True, "someone_else"
    clock[0] = 109
    response = client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={})
    assert response.json()["error"] == "wrong_account"
    assert not settings.session_path.exists() and reader.pending is None


def test_continuation_auth_validation_and_rate_limit(flow):
    _, clock, instagram, reader, client, headers = flow
    assert client.post("/v1/continue", json={}).status_code == 401
    response = client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={"password": "do-not-echo"})
    assert response.status_code == 422 and "do-not-echo" not in response.text
    begin(flow)
    instagram.check_error = type("PleaseWaitFewMinutes", (Exception,), {})("secret-upstream")
    clock[0] = 109
    response = client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={})
    assert response.status_code == 429 and "secret-upstream" not in response.text
    assert client.get("/v1/status", headers=headers).json()["code"] == "instagram_rate_limit"
    assert client.post("/v1/continue", headers=headers, json={}).status_code == 429
    assert len(instagram.checks) == 1 and not instagram.authenticating


def test_parser_rejects_dynamic_context_and_unrelated_actions():
    client = ReadOnlyClient()
    good = screen(APPROVAL, {"two_step_verification_context": "fixture-context", "counter": 8, "flag": False, "empty": None})
    assert server_parameters(client, good, APPROVAL)["counter"] == 8
    bad = json.loads(json.dumps(good).replace('\\"fixture-context\\"', '(untrusted-code)'))
    assert server_parameters(client, bad, APPROVAL) is None
    assert server_parameters(client, screen(VERIFY, {"two_step_verification_context": "wrong-action"}), APPROVAL) is None
